channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 28
item.description:
13 development commits

No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 27
item.description:
170 development commits

Structures & Combat

  • Balloon platform size reduced and now has its own signal alarm.
  • Balloon console can be typed at while its door opens, and the computer now hums.
  • Open doors now take full explosive splash damage based on their actual colliders, fixing previous reduced damage.
  • Large furnaces and water catchers can no longer be placed under conditional triangle roofs when placed first; they require floor grills or placement outside.

Dog AI & Behavior

  • Heel command more responsive, seek behavior refined, fetch enhanced, and dogs can now sniff sleeping bags, players, and animal corpses; distance confusion bug fixed.
  • Free‑roam dogs have reduced exaggerated leaning, no longer turn on the spot, and now play idle animations when stopped.

Player Appearance & Customization

  • Tattoos now correctly disappear on server wipe, fixing the bug where they survived when dead.
  • Added artist stool and other tattoo system improvements for easier customization.
  • Undergarments button now responds to clicks.

Rust+ Mobile App

  • Pairing screen now shows an error when trying to pair without any push‑enabled devices, instead of silently failing.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed a memory leak that could cause UI crashes and prevented downed players from being unexpectedly removed from the UI.
  • Corrected the raid window timer, ensuring the countdown displays accurately for players.

Performance & Stability

  • Resolved a DLSS startup issue that could hang the GPU, improving game launch stability for DLSS users.

Quality of Life

  • Item option icons now display correctly when panels are active.
  • Panels chat emoji videos stop correctly instead of looping until disconnect.
  • Tattoo chairs now have proper colliders, restoring interaction.
  • Balloon signal alarm volume and pitch tuned for clearer audio cues.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 26
item.description:
197 development commits

World & Environment

  • Tree respawn logic improved to refill missing trees, preserve grove shapes, and avoid overfilling.

Vehicles

  • Car chassis now stays networked at long distances, preventing it from disappearing before players can see it.

Stability & Networking

  • Fixed a null‑reference crash on the F1 Net page when connecting via Steamworks; the debug string now returns an empty string, preventing client and server crashes.

Outpost Extraction Overhaul

  • Each extraction raid now receives its own time‑of‑day and weather, advancing six time slots and rolling a weather entry from the mode’s table.
  • Snow jacket is now sold for 20 scrap in the supplies shop, making it affordable for cold‑weather raids.
  • UI and HUD for extraction mode have been revamped: aligned inventory, stash and supplier panels; updated compass markers; refreshed HUD vitals; extraction maps rendered as survey‑style prints with improved navigation; and a new balloon marker indicates extraction points.

Crafting & Resources

  • The composter loot panel now shows progress toward the next fertilizer batch.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Panels pie menu now plays its selection sounds correctly.
  • Player lookup commands now correctly require a name, preventing unintended matches.
  • Closing the F1 menu no longer blocks subsequent menu clicks.
  • Net panel (F1) now displays actual ping values and is restricted to admins; side panel auto‑closes when access is lost.
  • Wire tool info now appears in panels on the crosshair, giving clearer readouts.
  • Connect and session modals restored the map button and full header image, improving navigation.
  • CCTV bookmark arrows no longer cause accidental camera activation when clicking nearby.
  • CCTV station bookmarks can now be dragged to reorder, allowing custom organization.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Modern sprint movement changes improve sprint feel and speed.
  • Premium queue skip quickjoin fix reduces wait time for premium players.
